services.name: Private Lessons
services.desc: Registration for the Fall 2026 Semester will be Sunday August 16 at noon. The Fall 2026 Semester will run from September 14-December 6. Preview classes now! Two-hour private lessons are perfect for 1-on-1 tutoring, a family activity, or date night for clay newbies and out-of-practice pros alike.It includes two hours of private instruction, and then your teacher will trim your pieces, glaze them and fire them later for you to have as a memento of your class. For a group of 4 and under you can keep 2 pots per person, and for 5 and above it's 1 pot per person (if you want more you can pay $15 per pot). We will email/text you when they are ready to be picked up, about 4 weeks after the lesson.

services.name: Summer Camps
services.desc: Registration for the Fall 2026 Semester will be Sunday August 16 at noon. The Fall 2026 Semester will run from September 14-December 6. Preview classes now! Summer camps take place every summer in July and August. Each camp session runs for 5 days, from Monday-Friday, 1:30-6pm. There will be separate sessions for kids (ages 8-11), tweens (ages 11-13), and teens (ages 13-17), and two open-age sessions (ages 8-13). Students will get a hands-on exploration of clay through hand-building, throwing on the potter's wheel, surface techniques, and glazing, and make projects such as: planters, ice cream bowls, story pots inspired by Dave the Potter, sculpture projects, and more.
